correctness.rationale: For the smooth algebraically-closed characteristic-7 family y²=x^10+x^7+a x^4+b x with smoothness b Delta≠0, the source computes 4×4 Cartier coefficient matrix of f³. Independently expanded f³ in symbolic coefficients mod 7; reproduced all sixteen coefficients and block rank criteria, determinant 3 b² U V², substitution V=0 -> b=3a(a+1), U=6a²(a-5)² and Delta=2a(a+2)³, and W factorization 3(a-2)(a-3)(a+1)²(a³+3a²-1). The irreducible cubic Q has no F7 root and three simple geometric roots, giving five smooth p-rank-one parameter pairs (2,4),(3,1), and three over F343. The rank of Frobenius-semilinear Cartier stable products shows p-rank (4,3,2,1) with a-number (0,1,2,2) by U,V,W cases. Independently checked 37 smooth F7 pairs with exact strata (29,4,2,2). The geometric conclusion depends on symbolic factorization/semilinear argument, not F7-only check.

originality.rationale: Kudo, Nakagawa and Takagi 2023 give precisely the H_{a,b} family and Cartier support matrix in §3.2, and study superspeciality (Cartier matrix zero) generally. Their same-family results and Elkin/Yui Cartier formula are credited, not re-labelled as new. The submitted characteristic-seven full positive p-rank/a-number strata and five geometric p-rank-one parameters are not supplied by the examined primary theorem/algorithm sections. Frei thesis studies genus-four a-number phenomena broadly but no displayed exact five locus found from read material. Originality is qualified by plausible unindexed Cartier strata.

value.rationale: A complete rank/a-number stratification and zero-dimensional p-rank-one locus in a natural cyclic-automorphism genus-four family is a motivated moduli degeneration invariant, with geometric versus prime-field distinction and sharp absence of p-rank zero and a-number >=3. It answers more than a routine single-point rank test.

limitations: Geometric count of parameter values, not isomorphism classes; fixed normalized family only; no Newton polygon or Ekedahl–Oort classification.
